label: 📤 Flatten array
description: Reshape an array column. Three modes: flatten one level of nesting (list-of-list → list); fully flatten (any depth → list of leaves); unnest to rows (one row per element). Use unnest_to_rows when downstream steps expect scalar values; use flatten_one_level / fully_flatten when you need to keep one row per parent entity.

mode.label: Mode
mode.help: flatten_one_level: [[1,2],[3]] → [1,2,3]. fully_flatten: any nesting depth → flat list. unnest_to_rows: each element becomes its own row, other columns repeat.

outputColumn.label: Output column name
outputColumn.help: Defaults to overwriting the source column. For unnest_to_rows, this is the new scalar column name.

keepEmpty.label: Keep rows with empty / NULL arrays (unnest_to_rows only)
keepEmpty.help: When unnesting, default behaviour drops rows whose array is empty or NULL. Set true to keep them with NULL in the output column.
